name: cpu_vision_pipeline
title: Computer vision pipeline
short_description: Feature tracking, optical flow and stereo depth on a camera sequence.

structured_text.description: Runs the classical perception front end of a robot or AR headset on a bundled stereo camera sequence: feature detection and matching, sparse optical flow between frames and dense stereo depth, using the OpenCV routines that robotics and vision software build on. The sequence and all parameters are fixed, and the work is spread over all cores the way production pipelines do it.
structured_text.metric_explanation: The score is the number of stereo frames processed per second through the whole pipeline.
structured_text.value_interpretation: Higher is better. More frames per second means a robot or headset can track and map its surroundings at higher camera rates with less lag.
structured_text.reasoning: Feature tracking and stereo matching mix integer image kernels, floating point geometry and heavy memory traffic, which is exactly the load that visual odometry, SLAM and AR tracking put on the processor.
